summary: La1-xSrxFeO3 thin films were grown by atomic layer deposition using La(thd)3, Sr(thd)2, Fe(thd)3, and ozone as precursors. The ALD window was found in the temperature range of 200 to 360 ◦C. The study examined the effect of precursor pulsing on film composition and discussed a model for the relationship between pulsing ratios and stoichiometry. The films were deposited on various substrates and showed different crystalline orientations after annealing.
evidence: Thin ﬁlms of La 1-xSrxFeO3 have been prepared by the ALD (atomic layer deposition) technique using La(thd)3 (Hthd = 2,2,6,6-tetramethylheptane-3,5-dione), Sr(thd)2, Fe(thd)3, and ozone as precursors. A so-called ALD window is found in the temperature range 200 to 360 ◦C for LaFeO3. The effect of the pulsing procedure for the precursors on the composition of the films is examined.
